body.description: the Keeper of the dry creek, a tall thin old-world cleaning machine the size of a person, a narrow sun-bleached white body on a single rolling base, two long jointed arms holding a worn broom and a dustpan, a cracked speaker grille for a mouth, one dim blue eye lens, rags tied to it like a shawl; it sweeps the sand at night and keens, and the town calls it La Llorona. no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy

body.action_description: idle: sweeping the ground slowly with its broom, swaying on its base
rolling forward on its base, broom held out
